suggestions.title: Nissan Ariya 63kWh Engage+: insurance group not confirmed
suggestions.message: Couldn't find a trustworthy source naming the insurance group for the 2026 Ariya 63kWh Engage+, so the stored 31 is still unverified. Price (£37,000) and range (250 miles) checked out fine. #cardata

suggestions.title: Renault Megane E-Tech EV60 Techno: no longer sold new
suggestions.message: Status current → discontinued, on sale until 2026. The updated Megane (UK orders from 1 Oct 2026) swaps the 60 kWh battery for a 67 kWh one (306 miles, Techno from £31,995 before the grant), so the EV60 Techno is gone; you may want to add the new version as a separate car. #cardata

suggestions.title: Renault 5 52kWh Comfort / Iconic: price is after the grant
suggestions.message: Price £23,945 → £27,695. £23,945 is the techno+ 52kWh price after the £3,750 Electric Car Grant; the list price (RRP) before the grant is £27,695. #cardata

suggestions.title: Renault 5 52kWh: updated model on order
suggestions.message: An updated Renault 5 went on UK order in Sept 2026; its 52kWh version is rated up to 267 miles WLTP (stored car: 252). Worth checking on renault.co.uk whether the 2025 version is still sold or should be replaced by a new entry. #cardata

suggestions.title: BYD Atto 2 Comfort 64.8 kWh: price up £15
suggestions.message: Price £34,950 → £34,965, the list price Auto Express shows for the 150kW Comfort 65kWh. Small change, from one source. #cardata

suggestions.title: BYD Atto 2 Comfort 64.8 kWh: range may be higher
suggestions.message: Stored range is 261 miles, but Auto Express says 270 and EV Database 267 WLTP miles. Not changed because no BYD UK figure was found; worth checking byd.com/uk. #cardata

suggestions.title: MG ZS EV SE Long Range 73 kWh: no longer sold new
suggestions.message: Status current → discontinued, on sale until 2025. Fleet News lists it as 'no longer for sale' (available until 07-2025) and Autocar/Electrifying report the MG S5 EV replaced it, though Auto Express still shows a £32,995 price, so worth a quick look at mg.co.uk first. #cardata

suggestions.title: Renault 5 52kWh Comfort / Iconic: Iconic price higher
suggestions.message: Price £27,695 → £29,185. Auto Express lists the 52kWh Iconic Five Comfort Range at £29,185 (Techno is £27,185); £27,695 looks like a lower trim. The £3,750 Electric Car Grant applies but this is the RRP before it. #cardata

suggestions.title: Nissan Ariya: missing trim 87kWh Advance
suggestions.message: The facelifted 2026 Ariya is sold in the UK as 63kWh Engage+ and 87kWh Advance, but EV Rivals only has the Engage+. Duplicate the 63kWh Engage+ and set the version and 87 kWh battery; please check price (sources say £43,415–£43,425), range, power, 0-62, weight and insurance group, as Nissan hasn't confirmed UK figures yet. #cardata #newtrim

suggestions.title: Kia EV2 61 kWh Air: price
suggestions.message: UK price has risen from £26,995 to £27,995 on Kia UK's price list. #cardata
suggestions.detail: Kia UK pricing page: 'Air' 61.0kWh 133bhp, OTR £27,995 before the Electric Car Grant (£24,245 including the grant and Kia's own reservation saving). Insurance group 20 confirmed on the same page.

suggestions.title: Kia EV9 99.8 kWh Air RWD: price
suggestions.message: UK price has risen from £64,995 to £66,645 on Kia UK's price list. #cardata
suggestions.detail: Kia UK pricing page: 'Air' 99.8kWh 200bhp RWD, retail £65,805, OTR £66,645. Range 349 miles and insurance group 45 confirmed on the same page. Note: Kia's page doesn't state the Air's seat count (only GT-Line S and GT are shown as 6/7-seat), so you may want to check the '7 seats' in the version name.

suggestions.title: Kia EV2 61 kWh GT-Line: new trim
suggestions.message: A UK trim not in the list yet. #cardata
suggestions.detail: Copies the EV2 61 kWh Air. Kia UK lists GT-Line 61.0kWh 133bhp at OTR £32,745 (£28,995 with grant/saving), insurance group 21. It has 19-inch wheels vs the Air's 16-inch, so range and weight probably differ — not verified, please check Kia's spec sheet.

suggestions.title: Kia EV2 61 kWh GT-Line S: new trim
suggestions.message: A UK trim not in the list yet. #cardata
suggestions.detail: Copies the EV2 61 kWh Air. Kia UK lists GT-Line S 61.0kWh 133bhp at OTR £36,345 (£32,595 with grant/saving; £37,045 with heat pump), insurance group 21. 19-inch wheels, so range and weight probably differ — not verified.

suggestions.title: Kia EV9 99.8 kWh GT-Line S AWD, 7 seats: new trim
suggestions.message: A UK trim not in the list yet. #cardata
suggestions.detail: Copies the EV9 Air RWD. Kia UK lists GT-Line S 99.8kWh 378bhp AWD 7-seater at OTR £77,645, WLTP range 313 miles, insurance group 50. Torque, 0-62, top speed and weight will differ for the dual-motor car but weren't verified — please check. Model year/on-sale dates copied from the Air.

suggestions.title: Kia EV2 42 kWh First Edition: new trim
suggestions.message: A UK trim not in the list yet: the 42 kWh First Edition, from £28,495. #cardata
suggestions.detail: Copies the EV2 61 kWh Air. Kia UK lists it at £28,495 (before the £1,500 grant), 42.2 kWh, 144 bhp (107.8 kW), up to 195 miles WLTP. Please check rapid charge (kW), 0-62 (about 8.7s per misterev), weight and insurance group, which likely differ but weren't confirmed.

suggestions.title: Cupra Tavascan 58 kWh Origin: new trim
suggestions.message: A new entry-level UK trim launched October 2026, from £39,995. #cardata
suggestions.detail: Copies the Tavascan V1 (77 kWh). Origin has a 58 kWh battery, 140 kW (188 hp) motor, up to 273 miles WLTP, 105 kW rapid charging, 0-62 in 8.6s. Auto Express lists it at £39,985 (£10 lower). Please check weight, torque, top speed and insurance group. The same 58 kWh battery is also offered on V1 and V2.

suggestions.title: Cupra Tavascan VZ 77 kWh AWD: new trim
suggestions.message: The four-wheel-drive VZ is on sale in the UK but not in the list, from £54,930. #cardata
suggestions.detail: Copies the Tavascan V1. VZ is 77 kWh AWD, 250 kW (335 hp), priced £54,930 after the July 2026 cut. Auto Express shows it as 'VZ1' from £55,510, so please check the price on Cupra's configurator. Range, 0-62 (about 5.5s), torque, weight and insurance group differ and need checking.
